description_expanded: The Road to the Triple Crown - Luxury Vacation Rentals on 30A with Private Pools and Beachviews Favorite features - 2 Private Pools - Heated Pools $150 /Night (Available Oct-April Only) - Elevator to all main floors - 2 Observation Decks - Beachviews - Pet Friendly - 8 Complementary Bikes More about The Road to the Triple Crown Sleeping a whopping 29 guests across 12 bedrooms, this is the place to be if you have a large event! Comprised of two beautiful 5,800 square ft. homes, The Belmont at the Beach and The Preakness at the Beach , guests will enjoy over 11,000 square feet of combined living space, a choice of two private pools, two observation decks and beautiful beach views, all just a three minute walk to the sandy shores. The Road to The Triple Crown is THE venue for multi-family getaways, corporate retreats, and large celebrations of any kind. With an elevator to all main floors and pets allowed, The Road to the Triple Crown offers inclusivity for everyone in your party without worrying about those that struggle with stairs, or guests that need to bring their fur babies. The Road to the Triple Crown is a one stop shop for all of your entertainment and lodging needs nestled in paradise. Book now and reserve the perfect venue!
